data.name: Chawki
data.gender_notes: Chawki is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Chawki means 'young, green shoot.' This name is derived from the Arabic word 'chawwakah,' which refers to a young shoot or bud. Chawki is a beautiful and meaningful name for a newborn boy in the Islamic faith. The name Chawki carries the meaning “Young, green shoot” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Chawki usually hope their child will grow to embody young, green shoot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Chawki belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young, green shoot.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chawki total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
